evidence.note: Rule confidence: LOW. On 83 instruments from 2008-01-04 to 2026-10-09, Accumulate calls returned +0.2% versus the average instrument over the next 13 weeks and Avoid calls -0.4%. Following the calls returned 8.8% a year against 9.8% for holding everything equally (worst fall -41% vs -44%). Treat Accumulate and Avoid as risk-control levels, not as return forecasts; keep a diversified core and size new positions at half the Max size until a rule passes the test.
